items.title: Shocking secret you won't believe! Emotional arousal in clickbait headlines: An eye-tracking analysis

judge.evidence_topic: The purpose of this paper is to fill a gap in the literature by providing empirical evidence of how clickbait headlines affect online users’ emotional and behavioral responses, specifically emotional arousal and intention to read news.
judge.evidence_empirical: An experiment was conducted primarily to examine the levels of emotional arousal evoked by two treatment groups of online news headlines, news and clickbait, compared to a neutral control group.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico (experimento) que investiga os efeitos de manchetes clickbait em usuários, conforme solicitado. O método descrito no resumo coincide com o extraído, e o achado principal é sustentado pelo texto do resumo.

items.title: Effects of Clickbait Headlines on User Responses: An Empirical Investigation

judge.evidence_topic: This study investigates the influence of a conventional method of delivering news headlines, clickbait, on online users’ perceptions and responses.
judge.evidence_empirical: An experiment was conducted on two groups of news headlines—traditional news and clickbait— to provide empirical evidence of the effects of clickbait on online users.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico (experimento) sobre os efeitos de manchetes clickbait em usuários, sem viés político ou eleitoral, e os achados extraídos refletem fielmente as conclusões apresentadas no resumo.

items.title: Exaggerated and Questioning Clickbait Headlines and Their Influence on Media Learning

judge.evidence_empirical: we conducted two online experiments, each testing a 3 (headline-type: accurate, clickbait-question, clickbait-exaggerated) × 2 (exposure: headline-only, full article) factorial. In Study 1, an online sample of US adults ( N = 629) was randomly assigned to one of six news message conditions. Study 2 ( N = 1,674) was a replication study
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico (experimentos) sobre os efeitos de manchetes clickbait em leitores, atendendo aos critérios de inclusão. O método descrito no resumo coincide com o extraído, e o achado principal é uma paráfrase fiel do resultado apresentado no resumo.

items.title: Seeing is not always believing: an exploratory study of clickbait in WeChat

judge.evidence_topic: The purpose of this study is to unpack the antecedents and consequences of clickbait prevalence in online media at two different levels, namely, (1) Headline-level: what characteristics of clickbait headlines attract user clicks and (2) Publisher-level: what happens to publishers who create clickbait on a prolonged basis.
judge.evidence_empirical: the authors collected longitudinal data in collaboration with a leading company that operates more than 500 WeChat official accounts in China. This study proposed a text mining framework to extract and quantify clickbait rhetorical features (i.e. hyperbole, insinuation, puzzle, and visual rhetoric). Econometric analysis was employed for empirical validation.
judge.reason: O artigo utiliza dados reais de engajamento (cliques e tráfego) de contas do WeChat para analisar os efeitos do clickbait, atendendo ao critério de estudo empírico com dados de usuários. O método de mineração de texto é usado para quantificar variáveis independentes para a análise econométrica, não se tratando de um modelo de detecção de clickbait, portanto, o estudo é adequado.

items.title: Did clickbait crack the code on virality?

judge.evidence_topic: Although clickbait is a ubiquitous tactic in digital media... we confirm that high-emotional headlines are shared more and show evidence that clickbait often leads to inferences of manipulative intent and source derogation. We confirm that, on average, clickbait articles elicit far fewer shares than non-clickbait articles.
judge.evidence_empirical: Using a controlled experiment, we confirm that high-emotional headlines are shared more and show evidence that clickbait often leads to inferences of manipulative intent and source derogation. We then use a well-known secondary data set containing 19,386 articles from 27 leading online publishers.
judge.reason: O artigo é empírico e trata do tema. Contudo, o método extraído está incorreto ao afirmar que não viu experimento no resumo, quando o texto diz explicitamente 'Using a controlled experiment'.
